existing_source_assessments.label: van Trijp et al. (2024)
existing_source_assessments.directional_finding: Little or no distal-ileal substrate degradation or local SCFA production was detected. One proximal-colonic participant showed increased unlabelled SCFA concentrations after the bolus. Separately infused labelled SCFAs traced product handling; they do not directly measure FOS/GOS-to-SCFA conversion.
existing_source_assessments.study_exposure: Exploratory human FOS/GOS mixture bolus studies with intestinal sampling and separately infused labelled SCFAs; acute and seven-day intervention contexts.
existing_source_assessments.study_finding: Little or no distal-ileal substrate degradation or local SCFA production was detected. One proximal-colonic participant showed increased unlabelled SCFA concentrations after the bolus. Separately infused labelled SCFAs traced product handling; they do not directly measure FOS/GOS-to-SCFA conversion.

assessment.study: Exploratory human FOS/GOS mixture bolus studies with intestinal sampling and separately infused labelled SCFAs; acute and seven-day intervention contexts.
assessment.population: Healthy males; sampled sites included distal ileum (n=6), proximal colon (n=1) and transverse/descending colon (n=1).
assessment.result: Little or no distal-ileal substrate degradation or local SCFA production was detected. One proximal-colonic participant showed increased unlabelled SCFA concentrations after the bolus. Separately infused labelled SCFAs traced product handling; they do not directly measure FOS/GOS-to-SCFA conversion.
assessment.effect_magnitude: No generalisable production rate, dietary dose or clinical effect is established.
assessment.evidence_summary: Little or no distal-ileal substrate degradation or local SCFA production was detected. One proximal-colonic participant showed increased unlabelled SCFA concentrations after the bolus. Separately infused labelled SCFAs traced product handling; they do not directly measure FOS/GOS-to-SCFA conversion.
assessment.limitations: An ileal null does not disprove colonic fermentation. Other colonic sampling was dilution-limited. Breath hydrogen and plasma responses are indirect; isotope-derived production estimates and compartment models are inferred, not direct labelled-substrate flux. Mixture results cannot be assigned to individual constituents or butyrate specifically; no food-equivalence or brain outcome is established.
assessment.retrieval_scope: Primary full text: study design, site-specific sampling, carbohydrate/SCFA results, separately delivered SCFA tracers, production estimation and modelling limitations.
